files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- About: an invitation to leave a review on the Nextcloud app store, and a Buy Me a Coffee link to support the author (web and Android); it replaces the former rating link.
- Spots: under the map, “N without position” is now a link that lists the spots without position; clicking a name opens its form to place it.
- Spots list: spots without position are marked “No position”.
